about: Weitz & Luxenberg is a personal injury firm with a single office in Los Angeles.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, pending review of a licence status
G1.evidence: 21 of 121 named attorneys hold an active California licence. 3 do not (Erik Jacobs: Inactive; Mark Weitz: Inactive; Laura A. Green: Inactive). No discipline is recorded against any of them, so this is a licence status rather than a finding of misconduct, and either record may be out of date.

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, incomplete: an adverse namesake we cannot resolve
G2.evidence: No disciplinary record is held against any of the 24 attorneys we identified. James S. Thompson could not be told apart from 8 namesakes, one of whom is not eligible to practise. Held open.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 121 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 67 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 1998-10-15, so it has been operating for more than a year
